fixes.en: Nousjadeul-Ger (TV)\nA humanoid combat powered suit. More mobile and more comfortable to ride than\nthe Regult, and heavily armed with shoulder cannons and handheld weapons.
fixes.why: Same version qualifier is "(TV)" in the shop name of this unit (u3306) and in the VF-1 Super Pack rows (u3305, u3349); align the display name.

fixes.en: Nousjadeul-Ger (Movie)\nA humanoid combat powered suit. More mobile and more comfortable to ride than\nthe Regult. Its design differs between the TV series and the movie.
fixes.why: Same version qualifier is "(Movie)" in the shop name of this unit (u3311) and in the Super Pack rows (u3310, u3350); align the display name.

fixes.en: Supreme Commander of the Zentradi Main Fleet and the central bio-unit\nof his flagship. He understands Culture, if only a little, and is ruthless\nenough to use any means necessary to seize victory. (CV: Osamu Ichikawa)
fixes.why: "Boddole" alone is not a glossary form (Boddole Zer); the same source phrase is rendered as Boddole Zer's flagship in u0752, and since this profile is Boddole Zer himself, "his flagship" is accurate.
Glossary organizations.json fixes this unit name as "Irina Squad".
